entities.name: Furnace of Rath
entities.description: A cavernous molten chamber in the Hub beneath the evincar's stronghold of Rath where flowstone is formed.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship whose crew invaded the Stronghold.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The event during which the Furnace shifted to Urborg.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A place on Dominaria where the Furnace was shifted.

entities.name: Flowstone
entities.description: Shapeshifting material formed in the Furnace.

events.summary: In 4204 AR the Weatherlight crew passed the Furnace of Rath as one of many hurdles on the way to Sisay.
events.quote: the Furnace of Rath were one of the many hurdles the crew had to surpass to reach their captain, Sisay

events.summary: During the Rathi Overlay the Furnace was shifted to Urborg in Dominaria.
events.quote: During the Rathi Overlay , the Furnace was shifted to Urborg in Dominaria
